Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring school employee recommendations to include information of sexual misconduct, if any.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to school employees' letters of recommendation; andadding a new section to chapter 28A.400 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.400RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A school district employee under this chapter must disclose in anyletter of recommendation any inappropriate behavior of a sexual natureon school premises, during a school activity, or in the use of schoolproperty or facilities. Activities or materials used in conjunctionwith established curriculum shall not be considered inappropriate underthis section.
